verdict.rationale: monday.com documents an official hosted MCP URL for connecting agents. It also references 'the monday MCP' for Claude, Copilot and ChatGPT, plus a separate developer MCP, and a probe confirms a first-party MCP servers docs page. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the MCP tool surface and auth flow, independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP connection working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Use our native integration, or manually connect with our hosted MCP url.
Work with tools like Claude, Copilot, and ChatGPT through official integrations or the monday MCP
Connect the developer MCP to any agent.
